# EDA findings (auto-generated from the database)

- Period: 03 Nov 2025 to 02 Nov 2026, 8,760 hourly records.
- PM2.5: mean 73.6, median 58.6, max 353.9 µg/m³ (on 16 Jan 2026, 08:00).
- 365 of 365 measured days (100%) had a daily mean PM2.5 above the WHO guideline of 15 µg/m³; 329 days exceeded the PM10 guideline of 45.
- Worst month: 2026-01 (mean 151.5). Cleanest month: 2026-04 (mean 27.7).
- Daily pattern: highest average at 23:00 (90.9), lowest at 15:00 (44.1).
- Winter (Nov-Feb) mean PM2.5 114.8 vs 53.5 in the other months.
- Correlation of PM2.5 with weather: Temperature -0.63, Humidity +0.55, Wind speed -0.38, Pressure +0.43, Rain -0.06. Strongest: Temperature.
- Strongest weather correlation per pollutant: PM2.5: Temperature (-0.63); PM10: Humidity (+0.29); NO2: Temperature (-0.48); O3: Temperature (+0.57); CO: Temperature (-0.58); SO2: Pressure (+0.49).
- Mean PM2.5 in hours with rain: 52.0 vs 75.4 in dry hours.

Note: correlation shows association, not proof that one thing causes another.
